debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d a t-a-r-g-e-t-i-n-g p-l-a-n f-o-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a r-e-c-o-r-d m-a-r-k-e-d a-s a c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e v-i-c-t-i-m-n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t
2) t-h-e p-l-a-n a-s-s-u-m-e-d c-o-n-t-r-o-l o-f a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s t-o m-o-v-e f-u-n-d-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h o-r g-o-o-d-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r p-a-t-t-e-r-n a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d t-h-e m-o-v-e-d f-u-n-d-s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r a-s n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g a d-e-c-e-i-t n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e i-n-t-o t-h-e l-o-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
4) t-h-e m-a-t-t-e-r w-a-s s-e-a-l-e-d a-n-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d w-i-t-h a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e t-o a r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-t-a-m-p a-s t-h-e o-n-l-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w o-f t-h-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e f-i-l-e
5) t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e f-i-n-a-l-e-d w-i-t-h o-u-t a c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e f-r-o-m l-a-w e-n-f-o-r-c-e-m-e-n-t o-r s-u-p-p-o-r-t l-i-n-k-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-a-l g-a-p a-s t-h-e c-h-i-e-f f-i-n-d-i-n-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-r-i-m-i-n-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
